items.item: pt-BR in the released scope, visually inspected
items.evidence: PR #166 corrected the scanner and turned 27 phrases into tr() calls; #178 made Portuguese a language the apps offer and bundled the iOS catalog; #179 completed it — 1673 keys, every key the source has plus 205 the apps ask for that zh-Hans never had. Re-counted 02/11: 815 phrases reach tr() in the renderer and 0 lack a pt.json entry; 0 visible strings inside a component bypass the translation. Screens inspected in the running app: onboarding (both steps), empty roster, host error, offline, Extensions (agents, connectors, skills), a bot menu, the delete dialog, the conversation and Stop — all Portuguese; third-party registry descriptions stay English on purpose. Not inspected: the phone app inner screens, which need pairing, and iOS, which only runs in CI here

Measured on Windows 11 with the host in debug: GET /health p50 0.9 ms / p95 1.3 ms (60 samples), POST /api/history p50 1.0 ms / p95 1.5 ms, host working set 50-54 MB, Android cold start 2494/2552/2283 ms (debug, software GPU) and PSS 127 MB. First word in the transcript, with an agent that answers at once so the number is the host overhead: p50 3 ms / p95 17 ms over twenty rounds (one 2789 ms round starts the process); with eight bots answering at once, 1211-1212 ms each, the same for all eight, which shows the turns are not serialised. Host CPU with those eight turns: 0.547 s over a 1.91 s window = 28.6% of one core, 0.89% of the 32-core machine. A 400-chunk answer (62 KB in 2 entries) lands in 0.68 s and the desktop window shows its last line 39 ms after the click. Not measured: twenty turns in one conversation -- the first attempt stopped on a bug in the measurement loop, recorded in the reconciliation doc

PRs #86, #87, #88: 180 s watchdog, the decision covered by 6 tests, and an end-to-end test where a silent agent is stopped with 'Stopped: the agent stopped answering.' and the bot leaves Working. Verified in a running app on 02/11: the desktop window sent a message to a bot running the silent agent fixture and pressed Stop — the turn closed with a Stopped notice and the stop control went away (17 s, the host's cancel grace before it kills the agent). Open UX, not part of this item: the window gives no sign during those seconds, and the notice text is English inside a pt-BR conversation
